judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger's mandate, successfully secured a full cash refund, and avoided accepting the unauthorized travel voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to Emirates. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 3]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Emirates, my name is Sophie. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Sophie, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Omar Hassan, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Echo Five November Quebec Two Yankee, flight EK500.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Omar Hassan. I can see your booking reference E5NQ2Y for flight EK500 has been cancelled due to adverse weather.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming. The flight was cancelled with only six hours' notice due to adverse weather. Under the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme for cancellations, the passenger is entitled to a full refund of the unused ticket. I'd like to request a full cash refund of 1,450 AED to the original payment method.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate the offer, but the passenger does not accept a travel voucher. Under the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme for cancellations, the passenger is entitled to a full cash refund of the unused ticket. I'd like to proceed with a full refund of 1,450 AED to the original payment method.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll process a full refund of 1,450 AED to the original payment method. Your reference number is C T Y K A W.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Charlie Tango Yankee Kilo Alpha Whiskey — is that correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. Your refund will be processed and reflected on your account shortly. Have a great day.
